entries.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
entries.jpTitle: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
entries.romanized_title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
entries.synopsis:
Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.

Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

entries.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
entries.jpTitle: 生徒会にも穴はある！
entries.romanized_title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
entries.synopsis:
Ume Mizunoe, a first-year student at the prestigious Fujinari Academy, excels in Japanese literature but struggles so badly in science that his chances of advancing are at risk. Hoping to boost his academic record, he joins the student council—only to find himself surrounded by a cast of quirky characters: a charismatic yet secretly shy president, a kind but intimidating treasurer, an adorably cheeky boy, and a tiny, stray-cat-like secretary.

Thrown into a whirlwind of chaotic daily life, Ume's school days are about to get a lot more unpredictable—and a lot more lively!

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『氷の城壁』第2期
entries.synopsis: Second season of Koori no Jouheki.

entries.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
entries.jpTitle: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士
entries.romanized_title: Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi
entries.synopsis:
At the center of a continent made up of eight kingdoms lies the Kingdom of Marronnier. Leading the nation is the female general Baribara, who has seven sons, each with a personality all his own.

Sleepy, benevolent, sensitive to heat, sensitive to cold, gifted with animals, proud of his swordsmanship, and always hungry—the brothers possess very different qualities, but they are united by a single goal: "Someday, we'll rescue a princess in a cool way!"

Before long, the brothers set out for the seven neighboring kingdoms as ambassadors. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unfamiliar lands?

Set in a medieval-inspired fantasy world, this tale of romance and adventure begins.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
entries.jpTitle: 『薬屋のひとりごと』第3期
entries.synopsis:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan's rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Hotel Inhumans Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『ホテル・インヒューマンズ』第2期
entries.synopsis:
Hotel Inhumans 2nd Season
Second season of Hotel Inhumans.

entries.title: Romelia War Chronicle
entries.jpTitle: ロメリア戦記
entries.synopsis:
Rising from the ashes, a fallen noblewoman stands to save humanity!

After the Demon King's defeat, Countess Romelia's world is shattered when Prince Henri, her fiancé, publicly breaks off their engagement, dismissing her as "useless" alongside his new allies: Saint Elizabeth, the sage Ekaterina, and the swordswoman Lu Hime. What they don't realize is that Romelia possesses a secret power called "Grace," which brings her extraordinary luck. Left abandoned and humiliated, Romelia refuses to give up. With her homeland still under siege by the remnants of the demon army and her people enslaved, she embarks on a desperate mission to save them.

Facing overwhelming challenges—no army, no healers, no funds, and only inexperienced recruits—Romelia uses her wit and determination to turn the odds in her favor. She seizes fortresses from local lords to build her forces, negotiates with the church for healing, secures funds from merchants, and has her soldiers gain experience through monster hunting. Against all expectations, Romelia rises from the ashes, leading her loyal followers in a daring campaign to rescue her people and prove her worth.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie
entries.jpTitle: #ゾンビさがしてます
entries.synopsis:
Set in a world where 90% of humanity has contracted and died from a deadly, virulent disease, only to rise again as attacking zombies, thirteen years have passed since the "Red Day" of societal collapse. The surviving humans now live away from the big cities, still hoping to reclaim them one day. An entirely new generation, unaware of the pre-Red Day world, is coming into its own.

The story begins when Aki, who has no memories of the world before its fall, escapes her village with her close friends Haru and Natsuki to search for her missing father. As they venture into the outside world, they find themselves surrounded by zombies on all sides! Along the way, they rescue Yuu and Sakura and take refuge in a home improvement store. They regroup, and now the counterattack begins—!!

(Source: Kadokawa, edited)

entries.title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)
entries.jpTitle: 魔法騎士レイアース
entries.synopsis:
Three high school girls—hot-blooded Hikaru Shidou, haughty Umi Ryuuzaki, and gentle Fuu Hououji—have just met at Tokyo Tower when they hear a call for help that pulls them into another world. They are soon greeted by Guru Clef, a youthful-looking man who informs them that they are the legendary Magic Knights summoned by Princess Emeraude to save this magical land known as Cephiro.

While Hikaru finds the prospect exciting, Umi and Fuu simply want to return to their own world. Unfortunately for them, Clef explains that they cannot go home until they have saved Cephiro and banished the monsters plaguing it. In order to do so, they have to rescue Princess Emeraude from the clutches of the powerful Lord Zagato. To stand a chance against him, they must revive mysterious beings called Rune Gods.

As Clef grants the trio armor and magic, one of Zagato's servants attacks, forcing the guru to send the girls away to the weaponsmith Presea and the rabbit-like guide Mokona, who can further equip them for their journey. Though they have a long way to go, Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu will show that they have what it takes to live up to their titles as Magic Knights and bring salvation to Cephiro.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

entries.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
entries.jpTitle: 超巡！超条先輩
entries.synopsis: In Chinjuku, the city that never sleeps, there is a psychic senior police officer who has powers beyond human comprehension! His name is Meguru Chojo! Along with his judo expert partner Nao Ippongi, this hilarious duo will keep the streets clean by any means necessary!

entries.title: A Certain Dark Item
entries.jpTitle: とある暗部の少女共棲
entries.synopsis:
In Academy City, where supernatural abilities are part of everyday science, the city's peace is upheld by an unseen force—the dark side. Among the covert operatives is ITEM, a four-member elite unit. With Rikou Takitsubo's tracking abilities, Frenda Seivelun's explosive expertise, Saiai Kinuhata's impenetrable defense, and Shizuri Mugino's overwhelming power as one of Academy City's seven Level 5 espers, they navigate the city's underbelly, taking on secret missions that never make the headlines.

As their latest assignment unfolds, the team moves with precision, unaware that their actions are setting the stage for a tragedy that will test their bonds of trust, friendship, and survival in the unforgiving darkness of Academy City.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『佐々木とピーちゃん』Season 2
entries.synopsis: Second season of Sasaki to Pii-chan.

entries.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
entries.jpTitle: FX戦士くるみちゃん
entries.synopsis:
When middle school student, Fukuga Kurumi's mother commits suicide after losing 20 million yen in FX trading (Foreign Exchange trading), she vows to recoup the money her mother lost "I'll easily get that much back!"

Now, when she is a university student she makes her long-awaited debut in FX trading, unaware that the world she just entered could turn from heaven to hell in the blink of an eye.

This is a cute and slightly dangerous story as it explains technical terms by thrilling market fluctuations as the chart drives up and down, which becomes more heated with the entry of quirky FX warriors: Yasuko Takane, Mochiko Kogane, and Mebuki Yamashi. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this world with unstoppable heartbeat moments and unrealized losses!?

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: Vertex Force
entries.jpTitle: バーテックスフォース
entries.synopsis:
Akira Toudou, a high schooler living in northern Okinawa, lives peacefully with his mother and his older sister, Haruka. However, behind their peaceful life lies a secret passed down through their family: Haruka has inherited a mysterious power from their father, known only as "Engine," and she has lived her life hiding this power from others. Akira, however, inherited nothing. He harbors an inferiority complex due to his own weakness.

Then, strange events began to occur all over the world. What is the purpose of the unknown enemy closing in on Akira and his friends? Now, with the fate of the universe at stake, a brother who has nothing and a sister who has everything must find out what they can really do together.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar
entries.jpTitle: 蒼き伝承 – Welsh & Shedar
entries.synopsis:
The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

entries.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
entries.jpTitle: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収
entries.romanized_title: Kashita Maryoku wa Revo Barai de Kyousei Choushuu
entries.synopsis:
Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the "Skypiercers," and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious...until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

entries.title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titan Arc
entries.jpTitle: 『東京リベンジャーズ』三天戦争編
entries.synopsis: Sequel to Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen.

entries.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
entries.jpTitle: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？
entries.synopsis:
Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)

entries.title: Blue Box Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『アオのハコ』Season2
entries.synopsis: Second season of Ao no Hako.

entries.title: From Far Away
entries.jpTitle: 彼方から
entries.synopsis:
Noriko Tachiki has dreamt of a beautiful fantasy land for some time, though her friends think it is only her imagination. One day, on her way home, Noriko stumbles upon a bomb disguised as a paper bag that explodes right in front of her. However, instead of dying, she is transported to a mysterious forest full of strange plants and creatures.

As she begins navigating through the woods, Noriko is suddenly attacked by a giant, worm-like monster. Fortunately, she is saved by Izark Kia Tarj, a swordsman who does not speak her language. Lacking the strength to survive on her own, Noriko decides to follow her stoic savior, taking the opportunity to learn the foreign land's language and be more useful to Izark.

Unbeknownst to her, Noriko is a crucial piece of an ancient prophecy. She is "The Awakening"—a being destined to unleash the greatest evil known as the "Sky Demon." With influential people plotting to capture Noriko for her supposed powers, both she and Izark must fend for themselves and overcome a future laced with chaos.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

entries.title: Psyren
entries.jpTitle: PSYREN -サイレン-
entries.synopsis:
Ageha Yoshina is a self-confident high school student who helps others for a fee. On his way back from a job, he finds a strange calling card with the word "Psyren" imprinted left behind in a phone booth and decides to keep it, unaware of its purpose. The very next day, Ageha discovers that his classmate Sakurako Amamiya has the exact same calling card in her possession. When he questions her, Sakurako asks him to save her, signaling the day his troubles begin.

Confused by the circumstances of this encounter, Ageha realizes something is wrong when Sakurako goes missing. In an attempt to figure out what is happening, he decides to call the number provided on the calling card and is asked a series of questions by a mysterious voice, ending with a final, cryptic question: "Would you like to go to Psyren?" Thus begins two teenagers' participation in a game of life or death within a strange world inhabited by monsters called Taboo. Granted the ability to use psychic powers known as PSI, the duo fight to return to the place they call home.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

entries.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
entries.jpTitle: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい
entries.romanized_title: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusenmochi Datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei toshite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
entries.synopsis:
Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

entries.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
entries.jpTitle: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す
entries.romanized_title: Tensei shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hitakakusu
entries.synopsis:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes... and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

entries.title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。Season2
entries.synopsis: Second season of Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru.

entries.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
entries.jpTitle: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
entries.romanized_title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni Kyouka Point wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
entries.synopsis:
Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points!

With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer!

(Source: Shochiku)

entries.title: Ao Ashi Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『アオアシ Season2』第1クール
entries.synopsis:
Ao Ashi Season 2
Second season of Ao Ashi.

entries.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
entries.jpTitle: 弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった
entries.romanized_title: Yowaki Max Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
entries.synopsis:
I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game.

After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum, and then become a curator.

So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.

But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?

(Source: MU)

entries.title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
entries.jpTitle: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
entries.romanized_title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
entries.synopsis:
Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length.

However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media.

Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: Tetsuryou! Meet with Tetsudou Musume
entries.jpTitle: てつりょー！meet with 鉄道むすめ
entries.synopsis:
Misaki, a university student, feeling the weight of everyday life and uncertain about her future, she longs for adventure and something she can be truly passionate about.

At the start of the new day on campus, members of the Travel Train Club (commonly known as the Tetsuryo Club) invite Misaki to join them, as she steps into the world of railways, Misaki's heart beats with excitement for the journey that awaits her.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2
entries.jpTitle: 『帰還者の魔法は特別です』第二期
entries.romanized_title: Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu 2nd Season
entries.synopsis: Second season of Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu.

entries.title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
entries.jpTitle: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べるⅡ
entries.romanized_title: Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II
entries.synopsis: Second season of Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu.

entries.title: My Girlfriend's Friend
entries.jpTitle: 彼女の友達
entries.synopsis:
Takeru Hidaka is an ambitious high school student aiming for medical school. He has just started dating his first girlfriend, Kaori Koga, and to everyone else, their relationship seems perfectly harmonious.

However, that peace is threatened when Kaori's best friend, Tomoko Yoshioka, begins to flirt with and seduce Takeru. Caught between loyalty to his girlfriend and Tomoko's advances, Takeru falls into a double life and a complicated affair. Now, he must navigate a web of lies that puts both his academic future and his emotional connections at risk, all while the constant threat of his secret being exposed looms over him.

(Source: MAL News)

entries.title: Tank Chair
entries.jpTitle: TANK CHAIR-戦車椅子-
entries.synopsis:
Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

entries.title: The World's Strongest Witch
entries.jpTitle: 世界最強の魔女、始めました
entries.synopsis:
When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, "Internet." This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means...

(Source: Yen Press)

entries.title: The Vermilion Mask
entries.jpTitle: 朱色の仮面
entries.synopsis:
The mask brings calamity. The mask revels in slaughter. The mask has a will of its own... Peru, a traveling mask merchant, possesses the ability to craft mysterious masks that give its wearers unique powers. In a city shrouded in an eerie atmosphere, he encounters Sonah, a mysterious young girl. As revelations unfold and inner conflicts arise, a young boy takes his first steps forward! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mask battle fantasy!

(Source: Orange Inc.)

entries.jpTitle: 生徒会にも穴はある！
